subject.title: feat(gateway): system change history RPC and Ask OpenClaw recent-changes panel

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `openclaw.changes.list` and its typed audit-history entries as a durable `operator.admin` gateway contract for native and web clients?
rationale: The implementation is additive, but the method and record semantics become a maintained cross-client API rather than an internal Custodian detail.

options.title: Sponsor the additive contract
options.body: Accept the operator-admin history RPC as the shared product API, contingent on real end-to-end proof and normal protocol review.

options.title: Keep history UI-local for now
options.body: Defer the cross-client gateway contract and narrow the work until the durable API shape is decided.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the additive contract
recommendation.body: Accept the operator-admin history RPC as the shared product API, contingent on real end-to-end proof and normal protocol review.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged journal phase and this reader phase make steipete the clearest available owner for the intended product and protocol boundary.
